name: mcp-marketing
description: Marketing Brain v1.0.0 Production Ready — plataforma MCP: Google Ads, Meta Ads, WhatsApp, Insights, AI Agent, Workflows

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:mcp && npm run build:app
scripts.build:mcp: npm run build -w @mcp-marketing/google-ads && npm run build -w @mcp-marketing/meta-ads && npm run build -w @mcp-marketing/whatsapp && npm run build -w @mcp-marketing/insights && npm run build -w @mcp-marketing/ai-agent && npm run build -w @mcp-marketing/workflows
scripts.dev: GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_ID=dev-client-id GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET=dev-client-secret GOOGLE_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN=dev-refresh-token GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN=dev-developer-token GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID=1234567890 GOOGLE_ADS_SKIP_AUTH_VALIDATE=true GOOGLE_ADS_FORCE_MOCK=true GOOGLE_ADS_LIVE_AUTH=0 MCP_STDIO_SAFE=true tsx mcp-google-ads/src/index.ts
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:core
scripts.test:google: vitest run --config vitest.google.config.ts && npm run test -w @mcp-marketing/google-ads
scripts.test:meta: vitest run --config vitest.meta.config.ts && npm run test -w @mcp-marketing/meta-ads
scripts.certify:lts: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run validate && npm run mcp:smoke && npm run compat:init && npm run build:info && npm run package:release
scripts.dev:google: GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_ID=dev-client-id GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET=dev-client-secret GOOGLE_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN=dev-refresh-token GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN=dev-developer-token GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID=1234567890 GOOGLE_ADS_SKIP_AUTH_VALIDATE=true GOOGLE_ADS_FORCE_MOCK=true GOOGLE_ADS_LIVE_AUTH=0 MCP_STDIO_SAFE=true tsx mcp-google-ads/src/index.ts
scripts.dev:meta: META_ACCESS_TOKEN=dev-meta-token META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID=act_dev META_SKIP_AUTH_VALIDATE=true META_FORCE_MOCK=true MCP_STDIO_SAFE=true tsx mcp-meta-ads/src/index.ts
scripts.dev:whatsapp: WHATSAPP_TOKEN=dev-wa-token WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID=dev-phone WHATSAPP_STUB=true MCP_STDIO_SAFE=true tsx mcp-whatsapp/src/server.ts
